# Usage design references

Generated with the built-in imagegen tool before implementation. These are design references, not application assets. Actual allowance proportions, reset dates, and counts always come from the existing workspace quota snapshot.

- [Desktop allowances](allowances-desktop.png)
- [Mobile dark sending guidance](sending-mobile-dark.png)

## Design extraction

The desktop reference uses a pale lavender canvas, white panels, restrained violet navigation, and large remaining counts paired with smaller allowance text. The two allowance panels have equal widths, generous interior space, quiet borders, and a divider above their reset dates. Sent and queued usage have separate teal and amber segments and explicit text labels. The generated reference's illustrative meter proportions and dates are not accounting specifications.

The mobile reference uses an open vertical list of sending guidance with thin dividers, readable body text, and a violet History link. Implementation retains the workspace's Plus Jakarta Sans and Space Grotesk typography, existing header/navigation, 34px page headings, themes, and reduced-motion page transition. Cards use 28px desktop padding (22px on narrow screens), 16px corners, 64px remaining counts, and a 12px segmented meter. Guidance stacks naturally on mobile and stays comfortably readable on desktop.

## Prompt set

Desktop: “High fidelity desktop UI design reference for a new Usage page in Mailloop, a Gmail outreach workspace. Upper page section at large readable scale. Plus Jakarta Sans body, Space Grotesk numerals, violet #6d4aff accent, pale lavender #f6f5fb background, white panels, dark ink #17142b. Navigation Compose Templates Contacts History Usage Settings, Usage selected. Heading Usage; description Your sending capacity, at a glance. Free plan and Sending enabled. Two equal allowance panels, Daily allowance and Monthly allowance, prominent remaining emails, sent/queued counts, teal and amber segmented usage meters with neutral tracks, UTC resets with local equivalents below. Generous padding, quiet borders, no glow, nested boxes, charts, billing buttons, decorative graphics, heavy shadows, or huge headers.”

Mobile: “Large readable standalone reference for How sending works on Mailloop's Usage page, mobile dark mode, portrait image with no phone frame. Plus Jakarta Sans, background #0b0a14, ink #ece9ff, accessible muted text, restrained violet links. Flat open layout, generous margins, thin dividers, no nested cards or glowing boxes. Vertical rows: Batch size (within remaining allowances, individual emails), Sending pace (normally about 5 seconds apart, Gmail can extend waits), Queue expiry (ready sends expire after 24 hours), Uncertain attempts (count at claim, remain charged, never automatically resent, check Gmail Sent), Gmail limits (accepted does not confirm inbox delivery). Review email history link at bottom. No illustrations or decorative graphics.”
